'''1998 Corellia Regional (Indianapolis)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]. It was the first SWCCG qualifier held in Indiana. Sixty players registered at the Holiday Inn in Beech Grove. [[Tim Harvey]] of Fort Wayne won with a 12–0 record and +132 differential and earned a Worlds berth.<ref name="list-53912">[http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/53912 swccg-discussion message #53912], [[Alex Alcalde]] (31 July 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010509192606/http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/53912 Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Corellia)

[[Alex Alcalde]] (Gold 31) made rulings during the event and posted the report. [[Joe Alread]] defeated [[Heath Scheiman]] by 5 in a rematch of their [[1996 Decipher World Championship]] pairing. Squadron Members [[John Sarnecki]] and [[Justin Stauffer]] played, as did [[1998 Origins Open]] winner [[Dave Nanninga]] and [[Steve Tolin]]. [[John Kaufeld]] assisted.<ref name="list-53912">[http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/53912 swccg-discussion message #53912], [[Alex Alcalde]] (31 July 1998).
